verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide explicitly documents built-in brute-force protection with temporary/permanent account lockout on repeated login failures, addressing credential stuffing/brute-force on auth flows; this is a documented, first-party security feature distinct from generic authentication docs. missing for 10: X, Y — no explicit bot/CAPTCHA detection evidence, and no independent/hands-on validation of the brute-force protection's effectiveness in production.
